description: This file defines the AnalysisRepository class, which provides CRUD operations for the 'analyses' table in a database. It includes methods for creating an analysis record, retrieving an analysis by ID, updating its status, and listing analyses by user ID.

classes.name: AnalysisRepository
classes.description: A repository class handling database operations related to analyses recordings.

methods.name: int create( self, user_id: int, resume_id: Optional[int], profile_id: Optional[int], target_role: Optional[str], status: str, score_overall: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Inserts a new analysis record into the analyses table and returns its ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get(self, analysis_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an analysis record by its ID.

methods.name: None update_status(self, analysis_id: int, status: str, score_overall: Optional[float] = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and optional score of an existing analysis record.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all analysis records associated with a specific user, ordered by creation date.
